hypotheses.physical_signature: 2-D FFT harmonic upward-continued Salem-Fairhead (2007) tilt-angle zero-contour sharpness and lateral dip-migration (z0=100 m vs z1=400 m) warped up-dip along footwall-directed (-grad Z_b) vectors by Z_b*cot(60 deg) onto near-surface fault emergence; coupled with hanging-wall rollover keystone curvature, aseismic geodetic-minus-seismic creep deficit, up-hydraulic-head advected Fournier silica/cation thermal disequilibrium (max(T_qtz, T_chalc, T_cat) - T_meas) + 2-m probe thermal walls + paleo-sinter vents, GeoDAWN survey-seam-vetoed K/eTh & U/eTh steps, quadrant-IQR-calibrated 4-fold LOQO cross-fitting, and exact 6-ring Bernoulli survival supremum self-credit Dinkelbach fractional-programming CELF allocation.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Normal and transtensional Great Basin faults dip 50-65 deg beneath alluvial basins of depth Z_b (median 316 m, p99 3.4 km), displacing subsurface gravity/magnetic/MT steps 400-800 m (4-8 px, outside the 300 m DTI kernel) basinward of the unmapped near-surface fault trace, while shallow groundwater smears hot geothermal upflow down-slope into cold/warm wells that retain high silica/cation geothermometer disequilibrium without surface hot springs or aerial-photo scarps.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Gently dipping Tertiary welded ash-flow tuff cooling-unit pinch-outs on basin margins, airborne GeoDAWN flight-block leveling seams (vetoed via acquisition_block_id_100m.tif), down-slope non-fault alluvial outflow plumes (mitigated via up-hydraulic-head back-projection), and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan (~1,330 m / ~1,205 m) wave-cut shorelines bordering conductive playas.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: First lane in GEMSDOE86 or the 92-repo fleet to implement (1) multi-altitude FFT Salem tilt-zero lateral dip-migration, (2) bilinear hanging-wall-to-footwall up-dip potential-field & conductive-gouge pullback onto surface emergence, (3) aseismic geodetic strain-energy minus microseismic catalog deficit + GeoDAWN flight-seam veto, (4) quadrant-IQR calibrated convex probabilities fixing H86J-MCSP's inverted NE prior-alignment and uniform-rank CELF dispersion bugs, and (5) exact 6-ring Bernoulli survival supremum self-credit inside a submodular Dinkelbach fractional-programming CELF allocator.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~22 min CPU, <900 MiB RAM via float16 memmaps; 100% SHA-pinned data already obtainable in sandbox)

hypotheses.name: Steerable 8-Azimuth Log-Cauchy Quadrature Wavelet Step-vs-Dike Symmetry Phase & Garland Poisson Magnetization-to-Density Ratio Jump
hypotheses.physical_signature: Directional 8-azimuth log-Cauchy quadrature filter bank separating odd-symmetric fault-step phase (phi = +-pi/2) from even-symmetric volcanic dike/channel phase (phi = 0, pi) in RTP and gravity simultaneously, gated by lateral discontinuities in Garland's (1951) Poisson ratio d_z(RTP) / (laplacian_H(Grav) + eps).
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Northern Nevada Rift Miocene mafic dike swarms generate strong even-symmetric magnetic ridges that trigger isotropic gradient and Riesz monogenic detectors; odd-phase quadrature symmetry suppresses dikes while preserving low-throw concealed basement fault steps under volcanic cover.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Steep intrusive pluton-wall contacts (Mesozoic granodiorite stocks juxtaposed against Triassic metasediments).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86J-MPC and H86J-MCSP used orientation-pooled isotropic Riesz transforms rather than steerable 8-azimuth log-Cauchy odd-vs-even symmetry phase coupled with Garland Poisson ratio jumps.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (2-D FFT directional filter bank; obtainable on existing stack)

hypotheses.name: Listric Hanging-Wall Rollover Tensile Fiber-Bending Inversion & Paired Antithetic Keystone Graben Predictor
hypotheses.physical_signature: Directional second derivative -d^2(Z_b)/dn^2 of Cenozoic basin thickness along dip-normal transects 1.5-4.5 km basinward of range-front master faults (Xiao & Suppe 1992 rollover mechanics), isolating tensile fiber-strain maxima where blind antithetic keystone graben faults nucleate.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Master range-front scarps are mapped in existing_faults.tif (and masked to zero credit), whereas paired intrabasin antithetic rollover faults 1.5-4.5 km under valley-floor playfairways host major Great Basin blind geothermal upflow zones (Dixie Valley, Bradys, McGinness Hills) with subdued surface relief.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential compaction synclines draped over buried paleo-topographic bedrock highs.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: H86I-HVFD computed isotropic biharmonic nabla^4(Z_b); no repo lane has modeled directional Xiao-Suppe rollover fiber curvature at 1.5-4.5 km hanging-wall standoff.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (obtainable on existing stack; core scalar hinge proxy incorporated into H86K-STDP plane 9)

hypotheses.physical_signature: Linear ridge eccentricity of 2.20 um Al-OH (argillic kaolinite/alunite/illite) and 2.25 um Si-OH (hydrated opal-A/chalcedony) SWIR absorption depth over low-relief alluvial fans, tracing vapor-zone H2S/CO2 steam-condensate leakage above blind geothermal faults.
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: Dry blind faults above deep boiling water tables lack hot springs and large scarps, yet acid-sulfate vapor alteration bleaches surface soils along unmapped fault traces.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Detrital montmorillonite-rich wash aprons eroded from altered Tertiary volcanic tuffs.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: No lane in GEMSDOE86 has ingested SWIR phyllosilicate/opaline hyperspectral mineral indices; GeoDAWN gamma-ray K/Th/U measures radioelement nuclear decay rather than OH/Si-O vibrational absorption.
